Subject: Staggered POC onboarding + success criteria — post-call recap

Anna — great meeting earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment going into the POC kickoff.

High-level scope (as discussed)
- Objective: Validate automated clinical summarization that reduces triage time for care coordinators by >=25% while maintaining >92% factual consistency on a held-out sample.
- Data: sample of 5k anonymized visit notes (you mentioned we can get the first 1k in 48h).
- Duration: 4 weeks of active evaluation + 2 weeks of extended soak for stability checks.

Success criteria (measurable)
1) Latency: 95th percentile inference per request < 250ms under typical loads (10 rps baseline).
2) Cost: per-1000-note token cost target <= $X (we'll publish after baseline run).
3) Quality: ROUGE-L and model-checked factuality >= target, and <5% hallucination per spot-check.
4) Reliability: no more than 1 outage impacting the job per month-equivalent run.

Owners and roles
- Pixl: Anna Lowe (product), James Park (infra/tech lead), procurement@pixlhealth.com (PO/contract).
- Redwood: Sofia Ivanova (AE / engagement lead), Marissa Cole (Customer Success / trial coordination), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer / onboarding & infra).

Immediate next steps (actionable)
1) Pixl to deliver the first 1k anonymized notes and a small sample mapping file (schema) by 2026-10-07 — owner: Anna / James.
2) Redwood to share network & infra checklist + ops runbook (attached) and a HubSpot mutual action plan link — owner: Ben / Sofia (shared).
3) Schedule kickoff engineering session (60m) in the week of 2026-10-12 — propose Tue/Wed morning PT.
4) Procurement to confirm minimal MPA terms or indicate redlines — owner: procurement@pixlhealth.com.

Attachments: redwood-poc-ops-checklist.pdf (ops runbook), network-requirements.xlsx (network/IP & firewall details). Both attached and available in the Drive link below.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C-Pixl-POC-onboarding (POC folder), HubSpot: HS-83421, Mutual action plan: https://app.redwood.ai/mutual-action-plan/PX-2026-0421

Questions we still have
- Any constraints on sample redaction beyond HIPAA fields? (we can provide a template).
- Will Pixl want on-prem/private VPC deployment or is hosted Redwood API fine for initial run?

Proposed kickoff calendar invite (Sofia / Ben / Marissa + Pixl team) once you confirm the sample delivery date.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a more prescriptive timeline once we confirm the sample date.

—
